claims.source_quote_ar: وهذا من البث والحزن والشكوى إلى اللَّه

claims.claim_en: Stylistic (asloob hakim): the verse's diction leans toward lamentation and complaint; the clause «ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوْا وَكَانُوا يَعْتَدُونَ» conveys sorrowful complaint and emotional reproach that both elicits compassion and justifies divine censure.
claims.needs_review_reason: Statement is directly supported by the cited commentary (al-Kashshaf) describing the tone as 'البث والحزن والشكوى'.
